FILED s543q (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28, CODE 6a1301ed = MAIN-READY-114 + records, v2-16500) by the Rosetta census B (docs/rosetta-plan.md section 6b; #2104).

THE SHAPE (neutral reproducers, run on the tree, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):

    my @subs = map(sub { $_ + 10 }, 1 .. 3);
    print scalar(@subs), " ", ref($subs[0]), "\n";
    print $subs[$_](), "\n" for 0 .. 2;
    perl: 3 CODE / 10 / 11 / 12
    PCL : 3 (empty ref) and then dies "Undefined subroutine &main::10 called at ... line 3."  (the elements are 11 12 13, the BODY's values)

    my @c = grep(sub { 0 }, 1, 2);
    print scalar(@c), "\n";
    perl: 2          (a code ref is true)
    PCL : 0          (exit 0, silent: the body's 0 was used as the condition)

    Control that WORKS: `map(+sub { 7 }, 1)` gives CODE.

WHERE (emitted Lisp): `(p-map (p-anon-sub "main" (lambda (&rest %_args) ...)) (p-.. 1 3))` -- the p-anon-sub form is handed to p-map in the BLOCK slot, so p-map CALLS it per element; the EXPR form must be a function that RETURNS the expression's value, i.e. `(lambda ($_) (p-anon-sub ...))`.  The parser's map/grep first-argument classifier takes a `sub { }` term as the block.

CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (taken): 0220 with `map { sub { $_ * $_ } } 0 .. 9` (the block form returning the sub) is byte-identical to perl -- its only cause.

PROGRAMS: 0220-Closures-Value-capture.


=== DONE (s543x) ===
FIX (Pl/ExprToCL.pm, gen_funcall_form's map/grep EXPR-form test): the BLOCK is the parser's inline lambda (or the
parser-less anon_sub); an anonymous `sub { }` is a func_ref and an EXPRESSION, wrapped `(lambda ($_) EXPR)` like any
other EXPR (`map(sub { $_ + 10 }, 1 .. 3)` is three code refs; `grep(sub { 0 }, 1, 2)` keeps both).  User (&@) subs
are calls, not this arm (`first sub { ... }, LIST` and `first(sub { ... }, LIST)` unchanged).  Probe
scratch/s543x/probes/m2-probe.pl 25/25 perl = tree (base 17): the paren and paren-less forms, `map((sub {..}), ..)`,
`map(sub {..}->($_), ..)`, the block returning a sub, `+sub`, `\&f`, a foreach over the map, the closures read the
global $_ at call time as in perl.  Rosetta 0220 `same`.  Guard Pl/t/listop-refs-01.t 7.
